part_3_finding_F14.title: The control surface pins the rehearsal to a whole-repository snapshot, so ordinary development blocks it
part_3_finding_F14.detail: require_current compares the worktree against the selected implementation commit's tree for all 73 control members, which include ordinary application modules reached through the import closure. Any unrelated commit that touches one of them invalidates the anchor and costs a full epoch cycle to restore. This is correct as a tamper control and expensive as an operating model.
part_3_finding_F14.not_fixed_here: loosening it is a change to a core invariant and must not be bundled into a re-anchor whose purpose is to unblock an attempt. Recorded for a deliberate future decision.
part_3_finding_F14.operational_mitigation_until_then: run the attempt promptly after an epoch lands, and freeze control-surface members between the epoch landing and the attempt. The drift diagnostic added in this epoch at least makes a violation report all of its causes at once.
